title: Host review of the stock BYH3 binaries for the first GPU step (roadmap G3+G6): g3dcore_on register writes/waits in cmupmucal.ko, DTZPC SMC 0x82000410 arguments in exynos-pd_el3.ko, the first ID/status registers sgpu.ko reads after power-on, and what exynos-hypervisor.ko's EL2 code does for HVC 0xC6000108/110/111 (forward to EL3 or not)
acceptance: Every value for power on / DTZPC restore / ID read / DTZPC save / power off traced to a stock binary offset and cross-checked with the pinned source
The S2MPU HVC handling at EL2 described from the stock exynos-hypervisor.ko, or stated as not determinable
No Apple or vendor binary committed; only offsets, values and hashes
